evidence: No documented connection between Tubby and Atkins. Retained deliberately as the dataset's example of a resemblance edge: asserted tier, rendered dotted, worded to make clear it is not a claim of transmission.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Both treat the mixing desk as the instrument and the arrangement as something to be performed rather than fixed. This is a resemblance we are pointing out, not a line of transmission we can trace.

explanation: Sometimes two people arrive at a similar idea separately. We think these two approaches rhyme, but nobody has shown that one led to the other, so it is marked as our own reading. It is kept on purpose, as an example of the 'our reading' tier and of the difference between two things looking alike and one passing something to the other.
